sprite.name: Snow Effect
sprite.notes: Falling snow over the whole screen (retail: unused NSMBW leftover). Colours are 0-255 per channel. A colour left all 0 keeps its retail value (white flakes, light blue glow), so you can set only the flake. Keep Glow Alpha at 255 when you set a glow: lower values darken the flakes. Tsuru port (code/tweaks/snow_colors.cpp). Every snow sprite in an area draws with its own colours.

value.title: Flake Alpha (unused)
value.comment: Ignored on Deluxe: the flakes fade by depth.

value.title: Glow Alpha
value.comment: Use 255 (retail). Lower values darken the flakes.

sprite.name: Angry Sun
sprite.notes: Follows the player horizontally, spits fireballs and does spin/swoop attacks.

checkbox.title: Stationary
checkbox.comment: Stays in place instead of following the player.

sprite.name: Mad Moon
sprite.notes: Ice version of the Angry Sun: spits ice balls and gives off blue light.

checkbox.title: Stationary
checkbox.comment: Stays in place instead of following the player.

sprite.name: Actor Spawner
sprite.notes: Spawns an actor at its position when the triggering event turns on. Nybbles 5-20 are passed to the spawned actor as its settings.

value.title: Triggering Event ID
value.comment: Spawns when this event is on. 0 deletes the spawner.

value.title: Spawned Actor Event ID
value.comment: Given to the spawned actor as its event ID 1 (nybbles 3-4). Only values 0-15.

value.title: Spawned Settings 1
value.comment: Copied to the spawned actor's nybbles 5-12.

value.title: Spawned Settings 2
value.comment: Copied to the spawned actor's nybbles 13-20.

checkbox.title: ID is a sprite ID
checkbox.comment: Checked: the ID below is a sprite ID. Unchecked: it is a profile ID.

value.title: Actor ID
value.comment: Sprite or profile ID of the actor to spawn (0-4095).

sprite.name: Light Source
sprite.notes: Coloured light with a light mask. Can follow a movement controller.

value.title: Attenuation Radius
value.comment: Radius = value x 0.25.

value.title: Light Mask Radius
value.comment: Radius = value x 8.

sprite.name: Effect Spawner
sprite.notes: Plays a particle effect and/or a sound when the triggering event turns on.

value.title: Triggering Event ID
value.comment: Plays when this event is on. 0 deletes the spawner.

checkbox.title: Spawn once (non-updated effect)
checkbox.comment: Spawns the effect once when triggered instead of updating it every frame.

value.title: Effect Length
value.comment: In frames. 0 = forever. Only used by updated effects.

value.title: Sound ID
value.comment: Added to 0x01000000 to get the sound item ID.

sprite.name: Fake Star Coin
sprite.notes: A star coin that does not count towards the level's three. Collecting it triggers an event.

value.title: Target Event ID
value.comment: Turned on when collected. 0 = none.

list.title: Spin
list.entry: Around the Y axis, one way
Around the Y axis, the other way

sprite.name: Magic Lift
sprite.notes: Copies the tiles inside a location and turns them into a moving platform. Use a movement controller to move it.

value.title: Location ID
value.comment: The tiles inside this location become the platform. The lift deletes itself if the location is missing.

sprite.name: Water
sprite.notes: Another name for this is H2O. It is refreshing in warm areas, but it could freeze you in cold environments, so be careful! The water also is the natural habitat of many enemies, so once again, be careful! Based on the lava sprite, there should be nybbles for delays before rising/lowering, but the giant waves don't seem to work on this sprite. Giant Waves (Tsuru's wavy liquids, code/tweaks/wavy_liquids.cpp): the Lava's own wave settings, for a zone-wide liquid. Water keeps nybbles 14 and 16 for its own settings, so its mini-wave width and height are the defaults.

value.title: Triggering Event ID
value.comment: The ID that triggers the water to begin rising or falling.

value.title: Target Event ID
value.comment: Once the water finishes rising/falling, this event is activated.

list.title: Rising/Lowering Speed/Direction
list.comment: Values with a * will cause the water to lower.

checkbox.title: Topless and Invisible
checkbox.comment: The water will have no top and the water effect will cover the entire screen, but the water collision stays where the sprite is placed. Use underwater background for this.

value.title: Unknown Value 13
value.comment: Bitfield of some kind.

checkbox.title: Giant Waves
checkbox.comment: When checked, this will create giant waves in the liquid.

list.title: Giant Waves: Height
list.comment: The height of each giant liquid wave, in blocks.

list.title: Giant Waves: Speed/Direction
list.comment: The speed of each giant liquid wave. Values marked with a * cause the waves to move left instead of right.

list.title: Giant Waves: Width
list.comment: The width of each giant liquid wave.

list.title: Giant Waves: Mini-Wave Animation Speed
list.comment: The speed at which the mini-waves on top of each giant wave animate.

sprite.name: Poison Water
sprite.notes: Water that is <font color="purple">poisonous</font>. Kills the player upon touch. Giant Waves (Tsuru's wavy liquids, code/tweaks/wavy_liquids.cpp): the Lava's own wave settings, for a zone-wide liquid.

list.title: Rising Speed
list.comment: The rising speed of the poison water.

value.title: Rising Height
value.comment: The height, in blocks, that the poison water will rise.

checkbox.title: Rising
checkbox.comment: If checked, the poisinous water will rise quickly.

checkbox.title: Topless
checkbox.comment: The poison water will have no top, but will be fully functional.

checkbox.title: Giant Waves
checkbox.comment: When checked, this will create giant waves in the liquid.

list.title: Giant Waves: Height
list.comment: The height of each giant liquid wave, in blocks.

list.title: Giant Waves: Speed/Direction
list.comment: The speed of each giant liquid wave. Values marked with a * cause the waves to move left instead of right.

list.title: Giant Waves: Width
list.comment: The width of each giant liquid wave.

list.title: Giant Waves: Height of Mini-Waves
list.comment: This determines the height of each mini-wave on top of each giant wave.

list.title: Giant Waves: Mini-Wave Animation Speed
list.comment: The speed at which the mini-waves on top of each giant wave animate.

list.title: Giant Waves: Bounciness
list.comment: This causes the giant liquid waves to bounce up and down.

sprite.name: Quicksand
sprite.notes:
Once Mario steps in, he will start sinking. Doesn't hurt him to stay inside of it, though.
If you use a location, make sure it sticks 5 blocks below the zone, or else it will not make the player die. Giant Waves (Tsuru's wavy liquids, code/tweaks/wavy_liquids.cpp): the Lava's own wave settings, for a zone-wide liquid.

checkbox.title: Topless
checkbox.comment:
Checking this removes the animated crest effect on the top portion of the Sprite. Creates a 'square' look.
Note: Only use with a flat ceiling or else will look strange.

value.title: Location ID
value.comment: Match with a Location to set the Area of this Sprite.

checkbox.title: Giant Waves
checkbox.comment: When checked, this will create giant waves in the liquid.

list.title: Giant Waves: Height
list.comment: The height of each giant liquid wave, in blocks.

list.title: Giant Waves: Speed/Direction
list.comment: The speed of each giant liquid wave. Values marked with a * cause the waves to move left instead of right.

list.title: Giant Waves: Width
list.comment: The width of each giant liquid wave.

list.title: Giant Waves: Height of Mini-Waves
list.comment: This determines the height of each mini-wave on top of each giant wave.

list.title: Giant Waves: Mini-Wave Animation Speed
list.comment: The speed at which the mini-waves on top of each giant wave animate.

list.title: Giant Waves: Bounciness
list.comment: This causes the giant liquid waves to bounce up and down.

sprite.name: Red Coin Ring
sprite.notes: Red coins appear when a player jumps through this ring; collect all 8 for a power-up. Event Duration (Tsuru's coin ring): how long the ring keeps its event on, in frames.

value.title: Target Event ID
value.comment: Use this to link the red ring with the red coins it spawns.

value.title: Event Duration
value.comment: Frames the event stays on (60 = 1 second). 0 = the game's own (60, or 24 in its other mode).

value.title: Target ID [NSLU]*
value.comment: Activates this event ID if struck, *Only works in NSLU

value.title: Unknown Value 5
value.comment: No visible change

checkbox.title: Place Behind Other Sprites
checkbox.comment: Unused; when checked, it will be placed behind other sprites. (1100 gives this result, 0x11= 17)

checkbox.title: Unknown Flag 15
checkbox.comment: Does something with physics when checked...

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Specifies which movement controller to hook to.

checkbox.title: Extended contents (+16)
checkbox.comment: Adds 16 to the contents (bit 28 of settings2). Contents 16 is the Acorn; 21 is the Hammer Flower, 22 the P-Acorn, 23 the Blue Shell, 24 the Poison Mushroom. 25-31 are unused by the game and can be claimed by mods (framework/items).

list.title: Contains
list.comment: The contents of the question block

list.title: Contains (extended)
list.comment: Contents 16-31. 21 needs hammer_suit, 22 p_acorn, 23 shell_suit; an unregistered 22-31 makes the game read past its contents table.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Known matched sprites: 70

sprite.name: Brick Block
sprite.notes: Just an ordinary brick block that can also be movement controlled.

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Specifies which movement controller to hook to.

checkbox.title: Extended contents (+16)
checkbox.comment: Adds 16 to the contents (bit 28 of settings2). Contents 16 is the Acorn; 21 is the Hammer Flower, 22 the P-Acorn, 23 the Blue Shell, 24 the Poison Mushroom. 25-31 are unused by the game and can be claimed by mods (framework/items).

list.title: Contains
list.comment: The contents of the brick block

list.title: Contains (extended)
list.comment: Contents 16-31. 21 needs hammer_suit, 22 p_acorn, 23 shell_suit; an unregistered 22-31 makes the game read past its contents table.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Can match to 70 for sure.

sprite.name: Hammer Flower
sprite.notes: New power-up from the hammer_suit mod. Collecting it gives the Fire suit, but the player throws Hammer Bros hammers instead of fireballs. Also available inside ?-blocks and bricks as contents 21.

sprite.name: Spike Top Bee
sprite.notes: A bee with a spike on top that flies like a Cheep Cheep swims. Yoshi can eat it, and bounces off its spikes when he lands on it. Follow the player makes it fly straight at them, up and down too, and never lose them (Type and Flying speed are then ignored). Needs romfs/Model/bee.Nin_NX_NVN.szs with a 'swim' skeletal animation; without it the Cheep Cheep model is shown.

value.title: Flying distance
value.comment: Value+2 (the Cheep Cheep's swimming distance)

list.title: Type
list.comment: Same values as the Cheep Cheep (the game's mask 0x609 allows exactly these). 3: distance before turning depends on nybble 8. 45° types always start facing left.

checkbox.title: Follow the player
checkbox.comment: Flies straight at the nearest player from the start, at the Deep Cheep's chase speed.

value.title: Speed
value.comment: 0 = default. Otherwise value x 0.25 of the default: 4 = the same, 8 = twice as fast, 2 = half. Works with or without Follow the player.

sprite.name: P-Acorn
sprite.notes: The P-Acorn (p_acorn mod): flies and glides like the Acorn, with unlimited air boosts. Also in ?-blocks and bricks as contents 22 (tick Extended contents, pick 22).

sprite.name: Shy Guy
sprite.notes: New enemy from the shy_guy mod: a Shy Guy that uses the Goombrat's mechanics, turning around at the edge of a platform instead of walking off it. Needs romfs/Model/shyguy.Nin_NX_NVN.szs with the animations 'walk', 'walk0' and 'walk1'; without it the Goombrat model is shown and the log says so.

list.title: Type
list.comment: The Goomba family's type field (settings1 & 0xF), read by the Goomba class (vtable +0x270, 0x603393F0, called from GoombaBase::onCreate). A Goombrat is type 0.

value.title: Type-2 variant
value.comment: Only read when Type is 2: (settings1 >> 4) & 3, stored at +0x1AC8 and used as an index into a speed table (0x60338434), so it picks a variant rather than an offset.

sprite.name: Actor Spawner (custom)
sprite.notes: Spawns 1-16 actors of a chosen sprite or profile, optionally only while a level event is on. Unlike sprite 726 the event is optional (0 = spawn immediately), it can spawn several with a spread, the sprite table is range-checked, and failures are logged. For a plain event-triggered spawn use codedx sprite 726.

value.title: Triggering Event ID
value.comment: Spawns while this event is on, and re-arms when it turns off. 0 = no gate: spawn immediately and never re-arm.

value.title: Spawned Actor Event ID
value.comment: Passed to each spawned actor as its eventId1. Only values 0-15 are meaningful.

checkbox.title: ID is a sprite ID
checkbox.comment: Checked: treat Actor ID as a sprite ID (looked up in spriteToProfileList). Unchecked: it is already a profile ID.

value.title: Actor ID
value.comment: Sprite ID (0-739 in a build with every mod) if the box above is checked, otherwise a profile ID. Bits 8-11 come from nybble 22, bits 0-7 from nybbles 23-24.

value.title: Spawn Count
value.comment: How many actors to create, 1-16. 0 is treated as 1. This is bits 4-7 of settings2.

value.title: Spawned Settings 1
value.comment: Copied to every spawned actor as its settings1 (nybbles 5-12).

value.title: Spawned Settings 2 (low)
value.comment: Copied to every spawned actor as settings2 bits 8-31.

value.title: Spawned Settings 2 (high)
value.comment: Copied to every spawned actor as settings2 bits 0-3.

sprite.name: Blue Shell
sprite.notes: New power-up from the shell_suit mod (NSMB DS style): the Penguin Suit's powers without its iceballs, worn as the Fire Flower suit; crouching while running starts a shell dash at full speed that bounces off walls, defeats enemies and bumps block actors. Also in ?-blocks and bricks as contents 23 (tick Extended contents, pick 23). The item is romfs/Model/blue_shell (an Ice Flower without it): it rises out of blocks and trembles while it lies there. The player wears the shell on the back (and a copy in front showing its belly); crouching, ground pounding and dashing hide the player inside it, and dashing spins it.

sprite.name: Cold Fuzzy
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (mods/cold_fuzzy, the porting kit's reference port): a Fuzzy that freezes the player on touch. Follows a path when linked to one by its movement ID. Defeated by a Star, fireballs or thrown objects.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Path controller to follow (movement type 3).

sprite.name: Poison Mushroom
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (mods/poison_mushroom): moves like a Super Mushroom; touching it hurts the player like poison water instead of powering up. Also in ?-blocks and bricks as contents 24 (tick Extended contents, pick 24).

sprite.name: Biddybud
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/biddybud.cpp): a flying bug that hovers in place or follows a movement controller, or (Behaviour: Walking) walks the ground like a slower Goombrat. Hurts the player on touch; stomping, a Star, fireballs, iceballs, ground pounds, slides, propeller drills and thrown objects defeat it. Needs romfs/Model/tenten_w.Nin_NX_NVN.szs (Tsuru's model).

list.title: Colour
list.comment: Frame of the tenten_w model's 'bud' texture-pattern animation.

list.title: Behaviour
list.comment: Flying hovers in place or follows the movement controller below. Walking moves along the ground like a Goombrat, slower, turning at walls and ledges; it ignores the movement settings.

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Flying only: which kind of movement controller to link to. None keeps it hovering in place.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Must match the Movement ID of a controller in this level.

sprite.name: Angry Grrrol
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/angry_grrrol.cpp): a spiked wheel that rolls after the nearest player, speeding up toward them. Only a Star gets past its spikes (and does not defeat it); fireballs and iceballs vanish on it. Needs romfs/Model/guruguru.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Top Speed
value.comment: 0.25 * (value + 1) units a frame. 0 is the slowest.

sprite.name: Basalt Bones
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/basalt_bones.cpp): a lava Dry Bones mini-boss. Its bones fly out of the ground and assemble; it paces 8 tiles either side of where it is placed and throws fireballs. A stomp or ground pound scatters it, and it reassembles; three stomps defeat it. Stars, fireballs and everything else do nothing. Place it above lava. If the zone's Lava has Giant Waves on, the waves swell while its bones rise and settle once it assembles. Needs romfs/Model/laron.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Defeat Event ID
value.comment: Turned on when it is defeated (open a door, spawn the goal ...). 0 = none.

sprite.name: Para-Bones
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/para_bones.cpp): a winged Dry Bones that flies up and down. Stomping, a Star, iceballs, ground pounds and propeller drills knock its wings off and it lands as a normal Dry Bones; slides and thrown objects defeat it outright. Fireballs vanish on it. Needs romfs/Model/nokonokoB.Nin_NX_NVN.szs and wing.Nin_NX_NVN.szs (and the retail karon).

value.title: Flight Distance
value.comment: How far it flies, in tiles. 0 hovers in place.

value.title: Wait Time
value.comment: How long it waits at each end, in half seconds.

checkbox.title: Starts Rising
checkbox.comment: Starts by flying up instead of down.

sprite.name: Cataquack
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/cataquack.cpp): a duck that walks back and forth, turning at walls, and charges a player in front of it (8 tiles ahead, 6 up or down). It never hurts: touching it flings the player (or Yoshi) 8 tiles into the air. Needs romfs/Model/poihana.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

sprite.name: Flaptor
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/flaptor.cpp): a bird that hovers or patrols, then dives at a player within 5 tiles below it, lands and takes off again. Stomping defeats it; touching it hurts. Needs romfs/Model/mokinger.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Patrol Distance
value.comment: Horizontal/Vertical only: how far it flies either side of its start, in tiles.

list.title: Movement
list.comment: Stationary turns to face the player. Any other value removes it.

sprite.name: Floaty Goomba
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/floaty_goomba.cpp): a Goomba riding a float that bobs in the air and drifts toward a nearby player. Stomp the Goomba and the float stays behind: it bounces players up, and a ground pound pops it. Needs romfs/Model/ukibofloat.Nin_NX_NVN.szs (and the retail kuribo).

checkbox.title: Float Only
checkbox.comment: Just the float, a bouncy cloud to jump on; no Goomba.

sprite.name: Gushen
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/gushen.cpp): a water spout that rises for 100 frames every 160; its spray column hurts players. Stomping defeats it. Tsuru's Gushen is unfinished: like Tsuru's it is drawn as a Star Coin.

sprite.name: Jumbo Ray
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/jumbo_ray.cpp): a giant ray that glides right in long waves; its back is a 4-tile platform to ride. Tsuru's Jumbo Ray is unfinished: like Tsuru's it is drawn as a Star Coin.

sprite.name: Peepa
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/peepa.cpp): a ghost that follows a movement controller. With a platform it carries a 4-tile ledge (2 tiles for the cloud) you can stand on, and never hurts. Without one it hurts on touch; only a Star or Yoshi's fireballs defeat it. Needs romfs/Model/teren.Nin_NX_NVN.szs (the platforms are the retail lift_han_* models).

checkbox.title: Carries a Platform
checkbox.comment: Carries the platform below.

list.title: Platform
list.comment: Any other value means no platform.

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Which kind of movement controller to link to.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Must match the Movement ID of a controller in this level.

sprite.name: Piranha Sprout
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/piranha_sprout.cpp): a small plant that lobs a seed bomb in an arc toward the player every 6 seconds. Stomping defeats it. Needs romfs/Model/nukunuku.Nin_NX_NVN.szs and nukubomb.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

checkbox.title: Upside Down
checkbox.comment: Hangs from a ceiling; the bombs arc downward.

sprite.name: Poison Piranha
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/poison_piranha.cpp): a Piranha Plant that turns to face the player and spits a poison ball every 3 seconds; each ball leaves a poison puddle that lasts 10 seconds. Needs romfs/Model/poisball.Nin_NX_NVN.szs and e_poison.Nin_NX_NVN.szs (and the retail pakkun).

sprite.name: Scuttlebug
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/scuttlebug.cpp): a spider on a thread that lowers and raises itself. Stomping defeats it, as do a Star, fireballs, iceballs, slides, ground pounds and thrown objects. Needs romfs/Model/gasagoso.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Lower Distance
value.comment: How far it lowers, in tiles. 0 hangs still.

value.title: Wait Time
value.comment: How long it waits at each end, in half seconds.

sprite.name: Sting Bee
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/stingby.cpp): a bee that patrols 4 tiles either side of its start, notices a player within 5.5 tiles and charges after them. Stomping defeats it, and Yoshi can eat it. Follow the player makes it chase like a Deep Cheep: it flies straight at them, up and down too, and does not give up. Needs romfs/Model/hacchin000.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

checkbox.title: Follow the player
checkbox.comment: Once it notices a player it flies straight at them, up and down too, and does not give up. Without this it only chases left and right.

value.title: Speed
value.comment: 0 = default. Otherwise value x 0.25 of the default: 4 = the same, 8 = twice as fast, 2 = half. Works with or without Follow the player.

sprite.name: Falling Chestnut
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/falling_chestnut.cpp): a spiky chestnut that drops when a player walks within 3 tiles of under it, then breaks up a second after landing. It hurts on touch and cannot be defeated. Needs romfs/Model/iga_kuribo.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

sprite.name: Giant Skewer
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/giant_skewer.cpp): a huge spiked pillar that waits 3 seconds, slams down, rests 2 seconds, then pulls back up. Hurts on touch; a Star player is knocked back. Place it above where it should slam. Needs romfs/Model/daikonbouBig.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Slam Distance
value.comment: How far it slams down, in steps of 108 tiles. 0 does not move.

sprite.name: Beep Block
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/beep_block.cpp): a red or blue block, solid and visible only while its colour is on. The colours swap every 4 seconds; every level starts on blue. Needs romfs/Model/beep_red, beep_blue, beep_red_hollow, beep_blue_hollow.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

sprite.name: Red-Blue Block
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/red_blue_block.cpp): solid and visible only while the Switch Block state matches its colour. The state lasts while the game runs (it starts red at boot). Needs romfs/Model/block_red, block_blue, block_red_hollow, block_blue_hollow.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

sprite.name: Switch Block
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/switch_block.cpp): hit it from below, ground-pound it or slide a shell into it to flip every Red-Blue Block between red and blue. It can be hit any number of times. Needs romfs/Model/block_on, block_off.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

sprite.name: Switch Block Event Activator
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/switch_block_event.cpp): turns an event on once the Switch Block state is the colour it waits for.

value.title: Event ID
value.comment: Turned on when the state matches. 0 = none.

sprite.name: Triple Block
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/triple_block.cpp): a 3-tile ?-block, placed by its left tile. Hit it from below for its contents plus a coin out of each side. The contents work like a ?-block's, custom power-ups 21-24 included; vines, springs and Yoshi eggs are not given by this block. Needs romfs/Model/blocktripa, blocktripb, blocktripc.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

checkbox.title: Extended contents (+16)
checkbox.comment: Adds 16 to the contents (bit 28 of settings2). Contents 16 is the Acorn; 21 is the Hammer Flower, 22 the P-Acorn, 23 the Blue Shell, 24 the Poison Mushroom. 25-31 are unused by the game and can be claimed by mods (framework/items).

list.title: Contains
list.comment: What it gives (as a ?-block's contents), plus a coin out of each side

list.title: Contains (extended)
list.comment: Contents 16-31. 21 needs hammer_suit, 22 p_acorn, 23 shell_suit; an unregistered 22-31 makes the game read past its contents table.

sprite.name: Music Note
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/music_note.cpp): hidden until its Music Note Manager (the clef) is touched; collect every note before time runs out. Needs romfs/Model/note.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Manager ID
value.comment: The Music Note Manager it belongs to.

value.title: Pitch
value.comment: The note it plays (0-15).

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Which kind of movement controller to link to.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Must match the Movement ID of a controller in this level.

sprite.name: Music Note Manager
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/music_note.cpp): the clef. Touch it and its notes appear; collect them all in time for the reward. Under 3 seconds left the notes flicker. Needs romfs/Model/clef.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: ID
value.comment: Its notes use this as their Manager ID.

value.title: Time Limit
value.comment: Seconds. 0 = 5.

list.title: Movement Type
list.comment: Which kind of movement controller to link to.

value.title: Movement ID
value.comment: Must match the Movement ID of a controller in this level.

sprite.name: Star Coin Shard
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/star_coin_shard.cpp): one shard of a Star Coin. Needs romfs/Model/star_shard.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Manager ID
value.comment: The Star Coin Shard Manager it belongs to.

sprite.name: Star Coin Shard Manager
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/star_coin_shard.cpp): when every shard with its ID is collected, a Star Coin appears here.

value.title: ID
value.comment: Its shards use this as their Manager ID.

list.title: Star Coin
list.comment: Which of the level's Star Coins appears (passed on as the Star Coin's own setting).

sprite.name: Minecart
sprite.notes: Tsuru port (code/sprites/minecart.cpp, early in Tsuru too): rides a path from node to node at each node's speed, carrying player 1 on top until the last node. Needs romfs/Model/truck.Nin_NX_NVN.szs.

value.title: Path ID
